# God’s Plan for Family (Ephesians 6:1)

## Emotional Focus
God’s gentle plan for how families love each other.

## Key KJV
“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.” (Ephesians 6:1)

## Gentle Retelling
God tells children to obey their parents and parents to be kind and not make children angry. When we love this way, home feels like the safest place.

## Coloring Prompt
A happy family sitting together at a simple table with soft light.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God’s way of love makes home peaceful.”
